NoTik chess dependencies (unmodified upstream files)

https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js/tree/v1.4.0
ES module from https://unpkg.com/chess.js@1.4.0/dist/esm/chess.js

Stockfish.js 19.0.0 lite single-threaded WebAssembly: GPL-3.0,
see stockfish-LICENSE.txt. Copyright Chess.com, LLC and contributors.
Files from https://unpkg.com/stockfish@19.0.0/bin/
Corresponding complete source and build scripts for this exact npm release:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/54fde71d90c7c403964f6cacef48f7bbec495df1
Source archive (free download):
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/archive/54fde71d90c7c403964f6cacef48f7bbec495df1.zip
Build: node build.js --single-threaded --lite -f
The UI communicates with the unmodified engine using UCI over a Web Worker.
Retain this notice, licenses and corresponding-source links when deploying.

Casual classroom rules: threefold repetition and 50-move draws end automatically.
